Matrix.Name: Post-Commit Pre-Publication Crash
Matrix.FailureInjection: PostgreSQL transaction commits, process dies before in-memory publication
Matrix.ObservedBehavior: Outbox holds committed mutation. ReconcilePendingMutationsAsync replays outbox row and catches up.

Matrix.Name: Pre-Publication Exception Boundary
Matrix.ObservedBehavior: Coordinator immediately marked IsHealthy = false. All read queries reject with InvalidOperationException.

Matrix.Name: Mid-Publication Torn-Write Boundary
Matrix.FailureInjection: Failure occurs between boolean plane and category plane updates
Matrix.ObservedBehavior: Seqlock version counter remains odd (write in progress); reader starvation mitigation acquires shard lock, guaranteeing atomic state or failing closed.

Matrix.Name: Pre-Checkpoint Crash Boundary
Matrix.FailureInjection: Memory planes updated, process dies before recovery watermark recorded
Matrix.ObservedBehavior: Contiguous watermark tracker retains last safe contiguous sequence; outbox replay is strictly idempotent via monotonic publication ordering.

Matrix.Name: Outbox Replay Interruption Boundary
Matrix.FailureInjection: Network timeout or exception during ReconcilePendingMutationsAsync
Matrix.ObservedBehavior: Coordinator remains IsHealthy = false. No read queries are admitted until replay succeeds 100%.

Matrix.Name: Restart Hydration Capacity Boundary
Matrix.FailureInjection: Database contains account ID exceeding allocated plane capacity
Matrix.ObservedBehavior: Hydration aborts immediately, coordinator marked unhealthy, partial plane is never served.
